The tautological hyperplane square equals 8; the primary paper establishes edge surface degree 8, so the incidence morphism is birational. Three explicit ruling lines have no common fixed point, so no curve is contracted, the proper map is finite and thus normalization. Independently simplified four-branch cross-ratio to exact j=24918016/45. One special-example theorem, not a general-conics claim.
